items.title: Show HN: AI Watermarkremover
items.raw_excerpt:
All the examples of non-breaking spaces that they showed were arguably places where someone nicely typesetting might well do the same thing. For example, in "FY 2025", or "$8.7 billion". (I've even done this a lot myself in the past.)
I wouldn't call this a watermark, but more a sign of likely copy&paste, if students' word processors weren't currently doing that. A "watermark" that invisibly identifies the text origin using Unicode tricks sounds possible. And maybe you could do some things with statistical patterns. Or you could, as some have done in the past, is to stego the identifying information in a way that's hard to spot but can't be denied later (e.g., the first letter of each word clearly spells out "john smith is a cheater who copied this from chatgpt").

items.title: 沈向洋：五个维度思考智能演进 机会不仅来自技术本身
items.raw_excerpt: 雷峰网消息，在2025 IDEA大会上，IDEA研究院创院理事长、美国国家工程院外籍院士沈向洋用五个维度梳理了智能演进的脉络：算法范式、智能载体、交互范式、计算架构与数据。  他表示，相比给出一个技术路径路线图，他更希望提出一个“识别机会”的思考框架，帮助创新者在智能演进中找到技术、产品与商业的切口。 算法范式维度：从模式学习走向目标驱动 AI 的算法演进的三个阶段：监督学习构筑表达与生成能力，强化学习引入因果与执行，自主学习迈向高层认知。技术本身从 Transformer 架构出发，向更高效、更稳健的体系演化；从自回归到扩散，再到混合式生成方法，这些变化共同推动智能的表达边界不断拓展。 智能载体维度：从符号空间走向物理空间 业界关注点已从语言和多模态模型转向世界模型与具身模型。这一变化反映出智能载体正从抽象符号空间迈向物理空间，“从理解世界，到改变世界”。世界模型理解物理规律与因果，具身模型则把感知、决策与行动闭环联通，使 AI 成为能在现实环境中施加影响的主体。 交互范式维度：技术与人的关系被改写 在人机交互维度上，沈向洋强调交互创新的重要性。过去 70 年，人机交互经历了命令行、图形界面、搜索、推荐到自然交互的多次范式迁移；每一次迁移背后，都对应着底层技术浪潮的变化。“今天的产品开发者必须看懂智能特性带来的交互机会。”他同时指出，自然交互内部也在分层：从被动响应，到交互式执行，再到具备提议能力的主动模式，交互方式从文本扩展到语音、手势乃至未来的脑机接口。 计算架构维度：性能、成本与能效的新平衡点 趋势是从通用走向专用、从单一走向多元。GPU刺激了深度学习的第一波爆发，但能耗与成本也不断攀升。随着应用多样化，推理、端侧、强化学习等专用芯片不断涌现；未来光子、量子、类脑等也可能在特定领域带来性能跃升。 数据维度：从静态教材、动态反馈到证据 在智能演

title_i18n.zh: 沈向洋：五个维度思考智能演进 机会不仅来自技术本身
title_i18n.en: Harry Shum: Five Dimensions to Consider in the Evolution of Intelligence, Opportunities Extend Beyond Technology Itself
title_i18n.es: Shen Xiangyang: Reflexionar sobre la evolución de la inteligencia desde cinco dimensiones, las oportunidades no solo provienen de la tecnología en sí.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 雷峰网消息，在2025 IDEA大会上，IDEA研究院创院理事长、美国国家工程院外籍院士沈向洋用五个维度梳理了智能演进的脉络：算法范式、智能载体、交互范式、计算架构与数据。  他表示，相比给出一个技术路径路线图，他更希望提出一个“识别机会”的思考框架，帮助创新者在智能演进中找到技术、产品与商业的切口。 算法范式维度：从模式学习走向目标驱动 AI 的算法演进的三个阶段：监督学习构筑表达与生成能力，强化学习引入因果与执行，自主学习迈向高层认知。技术本身从 Transformer 架构出发，向更高效、更稳健的体系演化；从自回归到扩散，再到混合式生成方法，这些变化共同推动智能的表达边界不断拓展。 智能载体维度：从符号空间走向物理空间 业界关注点已从语言和多模态模型转向世界模型与具身模型。这一变化反映出智能载体正从抽象符号空间迈向物理空间，“从理解世界，到改变世界”。世界模型理解物理规律与因果，具身模型则把感知、决策与行动闭环联通，使 AI 成为能在现实环境中施加影响的主体。 交互范式维度：技术与人的关系被改写 在人机交互维度上，沈向洋强调交互创新的重要性。过去 70 年，人机交互经历了命令行、图形界面、搜索、推荐到自然交互的多次范式迁移；每一次迁移背后，都对应着底层技术浪潮的变化。“今天的产品开发者必须看懂智能特性带来的交互机会。”他同时指出，自然交互内部也在分层：从被动响应，到交互式执行，再到具备提议能力的主动模式，交互方式从文本扩展到语音、手势乃至未来的脑机接口。 计算架构维度：性能、成本与能效的新平衡点 趋势是从通用走向专用、从单一走向多元。GPU刺激了深度学习的第一波爆发，但能耗与成本也不断攀升。随着应用多样化，推理、端侧、强化学习等专用芯片不断涌现；未来光子、量子、类脑等也可能在特定领域带来性能跃升。 数据维度：从静态教材、动态反馈到证据 在智能演
excerpt_i18n.en:
According to Leiphone, at the 2025 IDEA Conference, Harry Shum, founding chairman of the IDEA Institute and foreign member of the U.S. National Academy of Engineering, outlined the trajectory of intelligent evolution across five dimensions: algorithmic paradigms, intelligent agents, interaction paradigms, computing architectures, and data. He noted that rather than providing a technical roadmap, he aims to offer a framework for "identifying opportunities" to help innovators find entry points for technology, products, and business in the evolution of intelligence. 

In the algorithmic paradigms dimension, AI algorithms have evolved from pattern learning to goal-driven approaches in three stages: supervised learning builds expression and generation capabilities, reinforcement learning introduces causality and execution, and autonomous learning advances toward higher-level cognition. Technology, starting from the Transformer architecture, is evolving toward more efficient and robust systems, progressing from autoregressive to diffusion and hybrid generation methods, collectively expanding the boundaries of intelligent expression.

In the intelligent agents dimension, industry focus has shifted from language and multimodal models to world models and embodied models, reflecting a move from abstract symbolic spaces to physical spaces—from understanding the world to changing it. World models comprehend physical laws and causality, while embodied models integrate perception, decision-making, and action into a closed loop, enabling AI to exert influence in real-world environments.

In the interaction paradigms dimension, the relationship between technology and humans is being redefined. Over the past 70 years, Harry Shum emphasized the importance of interaction innovation.
excerpt_i18n.es: Según Leifeng, en la conferencia IDEA 2025, Shen Xiangyang, presidente fundador del Instituto IDEA y miembro extranjero de la Academia Nacional de Ingeniería de EE. UU., delineó la evolución de la inteligencia en cinco dimensiones: paradigmas algorítmicos, soportes de inteligencia, paradigmas de interacción, arquitecturas computacionales y datos. Señaló que, en lugar de ofrecer una hoja de ruta tecnológica, prefiere proponer un marco de reflexión para "identificar oportunidades" que ayude a los innovadores a encontrar puntos de entrada tecnológicos, de producto y comerciales en la evolución de la inteligencia. Dimensión de paradigmas algorítmicos: de aprendizaje por patrones a IA impulsada por objetivos. Las tres etapas de la evolución algorítmica de la IA son: el aprendizaje supervisado construye capacidades de expresión y generación, y el aprendizaje por refuerzo introduce causalidad.

items.title: Show HN: Build the habit of writing meaningful commit messages
items.raw_excerpt: Too often I find myself being lazy with commit messages. But I don't want AI to write them for me... only i truly know why i wrote the code i did. So why don't i get AI to help me get that into words from my head? That's what i built: smartcommit asks you questions about your changes, then helps you articulate what you already know into a proper commit message. Captures the what, how, and why. Built this after repeatedly being confused 6 months in a project as to why i made the change i had made... Would love feedback!

items.title: Show HN: Forty.News – Daily news, but on a 40-year delay
items.raw_excerpt: This started as a reaction to a conversational trope. Despite being a tranquil place, even conversations at my yoga studio often start with, "Can you believe what's going on right now?" with that angry/scared undertone. I'm a news avoider, so I usually feel some smug self-satisfaction in those instances, but I wondered if there was a way to satisfy the urge to doomscroll without the anxiety. My hypothesis: Apply a 40-year latency buffer. You get the intellectual stimulation of "Big Events" without the fog of war, because you know the world didn't end. 40 years creates a mirror between the Reagan Era and today.
